text:
Kai (Mktg): Need a tiny launch kit for Thurs PM — focus: benchmark narrative + quick ops handoff. Deliverables: 1) single-row microstory tile (mobile-first) comparing 3 model buckets, 2) two social cards (1200x628 + 1080x1080) with 2 CTA variants, 3) webinar hero (1600x900) + 1-slide TL;DR (900x506), 4) email header (600x200) light/dark, 5) inbound routing diagram (editable SVG) that shows canary -> fallback -> notify ops, 6) one-page brand+accessibility checklist. Drafts in 18h, finals in 36h.

Ravi (Design): Quick Qs: microstory tile — do you want an animated micro-sparkline (GIF) or static dot-sparkline PNG? And CTA copy examples?

Kai (Mktg): Static PNG for now (keep file count low). CTA copies: "Explore the tradeoffs" and "View benchmark". Keep CTA area modular so Growth can swap.

Ava (Growth): Please provide the social cards with an isolated CTA component and two copy layers; we will test both. Also supply 2x exports for retina.

Priya (PMM): Legal: anonymize model names ("Open model A/B/C"). Accessibility: every asset needs alt-text and contrast ratios. Add a short disclaimer line on the slide: "Representative workloads." Localization note: provide source strings CSV with keys.

Ravi (Design): Understood. Specs I'll use: microtile 640x360 (mobile), row height 40px, sparklines 64x12, font Inter, model name bold. Socials 1200x628 & 1080x1080, hero 1600x900, TL;DR 900x506, email header 600x200. Diagram: SVG with labeled canary splits (5/20/50) and telemetry hookouts.

Kai (Mktg): For the microstory grid, make it skimmable: bold model, one-line quality note (<=10 words), color chip for winner only. On mobile the model name should truncate after 2 lines.

Ravi (Design): Will include an optional micro-legend overlay and a tooltip frame in Figma with raw numbers. Export naming convention: launch_1717605555/{assetname}_{size}_{variant}.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder: upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/1717605555/drafts and finals to /shared/launch-assets/1717605555/final. Tag: "snap-launch-1717". Set permissions: marketing+growth+design.

Ava (Growth): For routing diagram, show path: client webhook -> Redwood Hosted API -> Canary split -> Dedicated fallback -> notify Ops (email + Slack). Annotate where cost-controls (batching, quantization) and rollbacks live.

Priya (PMM): Also include export guidance for speaker headshots: circular 96px, export at 2x PNG with alt-text template.

Kai (Mktg): Good. Drafts in ~18h please, final pack in 36h. Ping @Ava and me when drafts are up. Thanks! :sparkles:
